Precancer → Tumor → Late/Metastatic Progression Multi-omics
	

A curated, continuously-harvested collection of publicly available human multi-omics
datasets spanning the full tumor trajectory: precancerous lesions → early carcinoma →
advanced / metastatic. Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics are prioritized.

⚠️ Provenance & licensing. Every dataset here was downloaded from a public,
open-access repository (no controlled-access or patient-identifiable data). Each dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wei82/precancer-omics-data.
